    Visits by year

    Personal collections.

    Tags belong to a place. Collections update automatically as your visits change.

    Make a smart collection

    Date, rating and journey filters must match the same visit.

    You’ve been here before.

    Show an in-app reminder when you’re near a place with an earlier visit.

    Off until you enable it. Checks run while FootPrints is open and visible, and stop when you leave the app. FootPrints uses location locally without recording a trail. No background alerts are scheduled. A place is reminded at most once every 24 hours.
    GIVE YOUR PHOTOS A PLACE

    Import photo memories.

    Up to 60 photos, 80 MB per batch and 20 MB per photo. Dates/GPS are read from supported originals. Photos without metadata are kept separate and start with today’s date for review. Existing identical photos are skipped.

    Each checked group becomes a new footprint or a return visit at the selected place. Labels and tags can be added to existing places; their saved stories and media stay. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
    TAKE THE MEMORY WITH YOU

    Share a memory.

    Cards are PNG images. Trip books are PDFs with full stories and up to 300 pages/100 visits (80 MB). Card text may be shortened to fit. Exports contain newly rendered images, without original photo metadata.
    YOUR MEMORIES GO WITH YOU

    NTH FOOTPRINTS · 0.6.1

    What’s in this version?

    The journal’s steps so far, from first release to current version.

      The journal suite is here

      Open Journal tools for anniversary memories, batch photo import, timeline/calendar, exploration summaries, smart collections and nearby memories. Open a visit for a memory card or geotagged photo copy; open a trip to create a PDF book. Nearby reminders run only while the app is open. Country and region totals use your place labels.

      Still ahead

      Larger media collections, streamed backups, and worldwide detailed offline map coverage remain queued. Directions continues to open your map app; integrated navigation is skipped. Permanent APK signing is deferred until testing is finished.

      Download USGS maps from Map & directions or Preferences for offline U.S. coverage. Places explores online listings around your chosen area. “Nearest to me” compares your saved footprints; it does not search for new businesses. Use Find or choose a location in the editor for online place search. FootPrints is still in testing.
      KEEP THE MAP WITH YOU

      Offline maps.

      Download a topographic map around a saved footprint. USGS has detailed U.S. coverage; detail elsewhere is limited. Downloads use your internet connection.

      Saved areas

      Downloaded maps work in the atlas and location picker, automatically when offline. Use Downloaded maps in the atlas to preview them while connected. Hatched areas were not downloaded. Maps stay on this device, outside journal backups; clearing app data or uninstalling removes them. Search and external directions still need a connection.

      Map services and data available from U.S. Geological Survey, National Geospatial Program.
      PIN THE MOMENT

      Choose a location.

      Move the map beneath the pin, or tap a spot. You can also focus the map and use the arrow keys. This changes your draft only.

      Include a town or city. Your query is sent to Photon only when you search. Results may be incomplete.
